# Starter Templates

Templates give you a pre-built starting point so you can skip the boilerplate and focus on what makes your game unique. Each template comes with a ready-to-play world, scripts, and configuration that you can customize however you like.

## Available Templates

### Blank World

A clean slate. This template gives you an empty world with the HELIX defaults configured -- a sky, lighting, and a flat terrain. Perfect if you want to build everything from scratch without any assumptions about game mode or style.

**Best for:** Creators who want total control from the start.

[Get started with Blank World](/docs/getting-started/your-first-world)

---

### Roleplay Server

A full RP server setup with QBCore pre-installed, character creation, jobs, economy, and a starter city layout. If you're coming from FiveM and want to get an RP server running fast, this is your template.

**Best for:** Roleplay communities migrating from FiveM or starting fresh.

[Roleplay Server walkthrough](/docs/templates/roleplay-server)

---

### Racing Game

A complete racing game with checkpoint system, lap tracking, vehicle selection, and a leaderboard. Includes a sample track and the scripts needed for a multiplayer racing experience.

**Best for:** Racing game creators or anyone wanting a competitive multiplayer template.

[Racing Game walkthrough](/docs/templates/racing-game)

---

## Using a Template

To create a new project from a template, launch the HELIX game client and browse the **Worlds** tab. Find the template world you want, click on its preview image, and press the **REMIX** button. Enter your desired world name and press **CONFIRM**. The template files are copied into your project and you own them completely -- modify anything you want.
